on_path_failure.description: Exposed development geometry with the failed vehicle near the direct orphan-goal route.

lateral_failure.description: Exposed development geometry with lateral route offset.

bottleneck_merge_failure.description: Exposed development geometry with converging routes.

occupied_orphan_goal.description: Exposed reject geometry with the failed vehicle occupying the orphan goal.

calibration_go_criteria.admitted: Every expected admit must commit once, complete the orphan goal, remain collision-free with positive sampled margin, retain valid command authority, and pass the published-command audit.
calibration_go_criteria.rejected: Every expected reject must commit no route, preserve a frozen hold, remain collision-free with positive sampled margin, retain valid command authority, and pass the published-command audit.
calibration_go_criteria.dynamic_model: Each admission summary must record effective clearance, conservative braking capability, dynamic candidate counts, predicted completion time, terminal speed, and time-aligned minimum clearance.
calibration_go_criteria.comparator: Immediate commit is a stress comparator reported as observed; mathematical infeasibility or collision does not invalidate admission calibration, while infrastructure and safety-chain consistency failures remain visible.
calibration_go_criteria.anti_vacuity: Calibration must contain at least one admitted and one rejected case.

stopping_rule: Any valid admission or hold condition failure is a calibration No-Go. Parameters, geometries, seeds, and expected outcomes may not be changed after the first valid run of this manifest; infrastructure-invalid starts may be repeated unchanged. Immediate-commit comparator outcomes are reported without gating calibration Go/No-Go.
claim_boundary: This exposed development calibration checks the corrected two-UAV dynamic admission implementation. It is not qualification or sealed evidence and does not support arbitrary multi-UAV task allocation.

stabilization_revision.supersedes: dynamic_admission_v4_nonblocking_bridge only for new evidence; prior valid refusal remains archived
stabilization_revision.trigger: Only when a healthy UAV's measured horizontal velocity exceeds the unchanged 1.5 m/s component limit at the failure event
stabilization_revision.hold: Freeze the healthy UAV's goal at its failure-event position, command zero nominal velocity, and continue RA filtering
stabilization_revision.recheck: After three consecutive measured samples with each horizontal velocity component <=1.45 m/s, evaluate the existing dynamic gate exactly once from the current measured states and failed-vehicle braking envelope
stabilization_revision.timeout: At 2.0 s without stability, reject permanently and retain safe hold; missing or non-finite velocity cannot count as stable
stabilization_revision.preserve: Original v4 geometry, seeds, order, RA settings, clearance, route candidates, rollout, and valid negative result are unchanged
stabilization_revision.sequence: Run all calibration conditions from first seed in a new output root; only GO permits qualification, only qualification GO permits sealed and dependent comparison
stabilization_revision.stop_rule: After completing a paired case, an admission or safe-hold failure stops dependent later cases; valid baselines remain results, infrastructure invalidity is retried same seed, and no effective failure is discarded

corrected_phase: 独立新版本：速度超限后限时稳定再评价；旧有效拒绝保留
retry_rule: After completing a paired case, an admission or safe-hold failure stops dependent later cases; valid baselines remain results, infrastructure invalidity is retried same seed, and no effective failure is discarded
probe_scope: Exploratory bottleneck single-condition closed-loop probe after observing valid v5 refusal; not qualification, not sealed, not a replacement v5 result.
